Detailed Description

A UnaryOpUGen usually created using the function sign() when applied to other UGen instances.

It is not normally required to use this UGen explicitly. 

 UGen resultSign  = SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4).sign (); // creates a UnarySignUGen
You can also use a global version of this function, the above code would be equivalent as: 
 UGen resultSign  =  sign(SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4)); // creates a UnarySignUGen
See also:
